messages:
Ava (CS): Noticing onboarding sync failures for several new tenants since 07:30 PST — /v1/onboard returning intermittent 500s. Flagging impacted accounts so CS can coordinate outreach. @Diego @Priya
Diego (Eng): On a bridge now. Preliminary: job queue saturation in dedicated-pool workers after recent deploy. Attempting quick rollback.
incidentbot: incident-bridge started — https://meet.link/bridge-1719994321 (bridge open)
Priya (CS Ops): Can you share the impacted account list and ETA? I'll draft a targeted outreach: status, mitigation, next steps.
Diego (Eng): Impact = ~12 onboarding flows stuck in "processing". Pulling logs, initiating rollback (ETA ~12m).
Marta (CS Manager): :thumbsup: Prioritize P1/P2 customers. Offer immediate handoff + warmstart assistance. Recommend 1 hour account credit pending root cause. Priya please prepare templates.
Priya (CS Ops): Draft outreach below — please review quickly:

"Hi — we're reaching out about a temporary onboarding interruption that affected your integration this morning. Engineers rolled back a recent deploy; most flows are processing normally now. Immediate mitigation: re-trigger onboarding from the console; if you'd rather we do it for you, reply and we'll run a handoff. We'll also apply a 1-hour credit. We expect full postmortem within 48 hours. —Priya"

Marta (CS Manager): Looks good. Tailor for SLA-bearing accounts (mention credits + AM contact).
Ava (CS): Impacted accounts I'm seeing: acme-inc, betaai, edu-rapid, green-shop, plus 8 others in staging. Priya, I'll DM you contract notes for acme-inc.
Diego (Eng): Rollback completed — health checks returning 200s. Service looks green; keeping bridge open for 30m to monitor.
Priya (CS Ops): Sent personalized emails to P1/P2 accounts, posted templates to #cs-templates, and added a short survey link for affected customers: https://forms.company/onboard-issue
Marta (CS Manager): Good work. Schedule a 30m enablement session tomorrow to walk affected onboarding reps through manual warmstarts. Also capture feedback in the survey and escalate any renewal risk.
Ava (CS): Will coordinate enablement + follow-ups. Closing this thread after all emails are acknowledged. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
